checks.question: Reshape the supplied hexagon-to-square transition body. Retain the bottom hexagon with 58.8 mm circumcircle diameter, the overall height 63.3 mm, and all section centres and orientations. At half height, reduce the square cross-section from 47.0 × 47.0 to 40.0 × 40.0 mm; at the top, reduce it from 35.1 × 35.1 to 28.0 × 28.0 mm. Form a smooth continuous loft through those three sections, retaining the same section correspondence and general transition character as the supplied model. Increase the axial through-bore from diameter 14.7 to 18.0 mm. Keep the original bottom plane and world pose.
